rules.description: Disabled for NCBI_Taxonomy because Taxon nodes in ncbi_taxonomy.tmcf reference parent Taxon nodes defined in the same TABLE_MCF via specializationOf. dc-import-tool's ExistenceChecker only registers INSTANCE_MCF (node_mcf) nodes in its local graph and queries the remote KG for TABLE_MCF references, causing Existence_MissingReference_specializationOf warnings for newly added or absent bio/* Taxon nodes.

Guards against unexpected Taxon entity deletions (e.g., partial archive truncation in download.sh/format_ncbi_taxonomy.py) since NCBI_Taxonomy emits 0 observations and DELETED_RECORDS_PERCENT always evaluates 0.0%. Threshold of 3000 allows normal weekly NCBI Taxonomy renames/merges/retirements (~330/week avg) while catching large drops across ~3.04M Taxon nodes.
